```python
right = np.copy(left)  # Ensure left and right are identical

# Convert to lists for device memory allocation
```

### Triton Kernel Addition

Now, I'll write the Triton kernel to perform the elementwise addition and verify the output:

```cpp
#include <triton/triton.h>

using namespace triton;

__global__ void elementwise_add(float* left, float* right, float* output, int n) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < n) {
        output[idx] = left[idx] + right[idx];
    }
}

// Launch function
void launch_elementwise_add(float* left, float* right, float* output, int size, int block_size, int grid_size) {
    elementwise_add<<<grid_size, block_size>>>(left, right, output, size);
}
```
